comparator.sourceNotes: The 2026–2027 regulations index identifies the Chemical Engineering appendix despite its older running footer. The appendix and dated Ocasys course list confirm 60 EC first year, 105 EC upper-year core and 15 EC elective space in year three. Electives are selected from the listed options or approved by the Board of Examiners. The catalogue exempts complete university minors from individual approval. The standard single degree has no selected route.

alternativeSelection.assessment: One coherent programme combines biochemical foundations with resource recovery, environmental assessment, energy design and quantitative methods. A second direction centred on chemical production plants would lack enough cumulative engineering content across transport, reactors, separations and process design.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Both study biomolecular structure, enzymes and carbohydrates. UCR emphasises metabolism and biochemical function, while Groningen adds engineering applications and an integrated practical.
Both establish calculus and mathematical tools for later scientific work; UCR is general rather than chemistry- and engineering-specific.
Both develop numerical solution methods; UCR provides general computational mathematics rather than chemical-engineering applications.
Both use matrices, vectors and linear systems in quantitative work. Groningen combines linear algebra with multivariable calculus for chemistry.
Both use differential equations, Laplace transforms and feedback to study dynamic responses. Groningen applies them to chemical plants and industrial control equipment.
Both examine societal and institutional choices in sustainability. Groningen centres green chemistry and responsible innovation; UCR uses sustainability governance cases across sectors.
Both use life-cycle assessment to evaluate products and processes. UCR also considers circular-economy strategies. Groningen applies the method to chemical production.
Both address product development and evaluation; UCR teaches general consumer-product design rather than chemical product formulation and industrial production.

The UCR foundation introduces biomolecules in life science. Groningen studies chemical structure and reactivity more broadly.

notes.text: The UCR option covers selected biochemical, environmental and quantitative applications. Groningen builds a sequence in chemistry, transport, reactors, separations and equipment, then applies it in chemical engineering laboratories, plant design and a research project.

audience.programmeDescription: Chemical Engineering at the University of Groningen studies how to turn raw materials into products safely and efficiently. It combines chemistry and mathematics with laboratory work, process design and a research project.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The UCR option applies chemistry and quantitative methods to resource recovery, renewable energy and product design. Groningen also trains students to design and control industrial chemical processes.
